hero.title: Walked-up shooting
hero.subtitle: Six head per gun, rabbit or partridge, on the Villamanrique ground.

intro: Walked-up shooting covers the ground on foot. At La Calerilla the bag is six head per gun, rabbit or partridge.
points: Six head per gun: rabbit or partridge.
Offered alongside driven days, call hunting and releases.
It can be combined with a Bungalow Suite and dining on the estate.
